title: Site-of-Service Differential for Outpatient Surgery Close-Outs — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Finance schedule.** When the services still open on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) are valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), the site-of-service factor multiplies the whole member-decision value:

| Campus of the account | Site-of-service factor |
|---|---|
| Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute | 0.92 |
| Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton | 1.04 |
| otherwise (a hospital campus: Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah) | 1 |

Example (hypothetical): a value of 5,000.00 becomes 4,600.00 at Grand Chute, 5,200.00 at Chilton, and stays 5,000.00 at Appleton.
